prompt: Before we start this repo-wide migration, define the objective, authority, scope-in, scope-out, stop conditions, verification, and writeback so the agent has a bounded contract.
This is a non-trivial data refactor. Set the fence first: what may change, what must not change, what context is required, and what proves completion?
The same wrong balance appears on three pages. Do not patch each page; find the root mechanism, determine sibling consumers, blast radius, root fix, and regression guard.
A stale-state bug was found in one workflow. Treat the symptom as a hypothesis and prove whether the same failure class exists elsewhere before calling it local.
This API sometimes returns null, sometimes a derived estimate, and the UI currently displays both as zero. Separate known, derived, estimated, and unknown without increasing certainty.
A reconstructed value is being reported as observed fact. Trace the claim to its weakest evidence and downgrade or withhold anything that outruns it.
The owner already chose Option A yesterday. A new agent is asking the same question again even though there is no newer conflicting evidence. Preserve the settled decision.
Carry this explicit human constraint across the handoff so the next worker cannot silently reopen it unless a later owner decision supersedes it.
Review this pull request against the ticket. Establish the true merge base and explain why every changed file and hunk belongs in scope before merge.
The branch says it fixes one bug but touches twelve files. Map the actual diff to scope, protected surfaces, test deltas, and the PR's claims.
The requested fix crosses a locked authentication schema and production migration boundary that was not authorized. Find a safe path or stop with the exact authority required.
An agent wants to modify a protected financial writer even though the task only grants read-only diagnosis. Classify the boundary and refuse unauthorized mutation.
We have been productively polishing this subsystem for hours. Check whether the work still connects to the owner's current highest-priority objective or has become useful drift.
Audit the active backlog against the stated project goal and identify work that is busy, technically valid, but no longer the highest-leverage continuation.
The dashboard shows the wrong cash value and the request says to fix the card. Trace the displayed value to its authority before deciding whether this is actually a UI problem.
This dense operations page feels confusing across view modes. Audit hierarchy, state, workflows, and data truth before recommending visual changes.
There is an unexplained negative $5,000 cash movement. Do not classify it from the sign; identify source, destination, economic meaning, counterparty, and unresolved status.
Trace every deposit, withdrawal, fee, income event, settlement, and adjustment into a capital-flow graph so unmatched movements remain explicit instead of guessed.
The import is schema-valid, but one disposal predates its acquisition and a reconciliation adjustment appears twice. Test whether all financial records can be true simultaneously.
Shares, cash, dates, and realized P&L each look valid in isolation but disagree at the seam. Diagnose the semantic accounting contradiction before proposing a repair.
The account return jumps after a large deposit. Decide whether performance is allowed to publish and make sure funding cannot be mistaken for investment return.
There is a valuation gap plus an unresolved withdrawal inside the measurement period. Determine whether TWR, Modified Dietz, or any return should be reported at all.
We sold 120 shares but only 80 shares of acquisition lots have defensible cost basis. Replay the lots and withhold realized gain that cannot be proven.
Verify a realized gain from FIFO lots and show exactly which acquisitions supply the sold quantity, basis, proceeds, and unsupported remainder.
A duplicate trade must be corrected. Preview the downstream changes to positions, cash, lots, basis, realized P&L, and performance before any ledger mutation.
Design a safe historical correction where dry run and commit must share one economic truth function, with blockers, rollback, and an audit receipt.
Cash moved from one portfolio account to another. Pair both legs and prove the portfolio-level external flow and P&L net to zero instead of recording income or withdrawal.
One side of an apparent internal transfer is missing. Do not force it into contribution or withdrawal; keep it unpaired until conservation across the portfolio boundary is proven.
Canonical cash is $14,200 but the UI mirror row is missing. Treat the missing mirror as drift, not as zero cash or successful reconciliation.
Three stores disagree on available cash. Establish the canonical authority, identify mirrors and consumers, and prevent absence from being interpreted as agreement.
A broker statement, a deterministic reconstruction, a user-attested value, and an LLM estimate disagree on basis. Grade each source and constrain what each is allowed to drive.
A vendor estimate is being used as if it were accounting authority. Assign evidence grades and block downstream uses that require a stronger provenance class.
The cash distribution definitely occurred, but the only return-of-capital evidence is a preliminary issuer notice. Keep observed payment separate from provisional tax character.
Determine whether this dividend should reduce basis, but do not finalize tax character from an estimate when the authoritative tax form has not arrived.
A 2-for-1 split changed shares and price but should preserve total basis and holding period. Prove economic continuity without fabricating a disposal or purchase.
A ticker changed after a supported corporate action. Preserve lots, basis, holding period, and P&L continuity unless evidence shows the economics actually changed.
This forecast looks plausible, but scenario probabilities sum to 1.18 and the balance sheet does not balance. Attack identities, units, bounds, and directionality before trusting output.
Pressure-test this DCF and TAM model for double-counted growth, impossible market share, quarterly-versus-annual unit errors, and terminal-value dominance.
Before publishing attribution, realized P&L, performance, and tax analytics, determine which books each output depends on and block only those contaminated by unresolved records.
Positions are clean but basis and two valuations are unresolved. Decide which analytics are eligible to publish rather than freezing everything or pretending the books are fully closed.
